* '''Original''' ([[First Light: Dryden's Study]], 9 November 2020): Original: the image at the set's official release (9 November 2020). Players Committee card image, 9 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-firstlightdrydensstudy-20201109.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/First%20Light%20Dryden%27s%20Study_.gif Holotable commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards”], no mark). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Unless Vos on table, Force drain -1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[First Light: Dryden's Study (Errata)]], 10 November 2020): Players Committee card image, 10 November 2020: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-firstlightdrydensstudy-20201110.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/5794ee2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/firstlightdrydensstudy.gif Holotable commit 5794ee2 “image updates”], no mark). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Unless Vos on table, Force drain -1 here.” '''What changed:''' the same card image stored turned to landscape (1039×745, was 745×1039); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 2 January 2023): Players Committee card image, 2 January 2023: 0 side [[:File:V13-D-firstlightdrydensstudy-20230102.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/fba281d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/hires/firstlightdrydensstudy.png Holotable commit fba281d “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”], no mark). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Unless Vos on table, Force drain -1 here.” '''What changed:''' Remastered: the card was re-rendered with new frame details: art credit “Luca “LuP” Pettinelli @ ArtStation” (was “Luca "Lui" Pettinelli @ Artstation.com”) and copyright line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”; this image also shows a [Light Side] lightsaber icon in the Light Side icon box at the top; the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
*: [[File:V13-D-firstlightdrydensstudy-20230102-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''

Text: “'''Light Side:''' Add 1 to your blaster weapon destiny draws here. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
